minor.issue: Occasional 502 / very slow responses under load: 1st call timed out at 60s (502 from ingress), retry 21.8s, then 0.13s. Worth checking blocking work in the status handler / event-loop starvation.

Possible under-reporting (not caused by this change): backend log shows 'AI [market_observer]: nutzt groq/openai/gpt-oss-20b (Haupt-Modell: gemini-3.6-flash)' yet active_fallbacks stayed []. record_result uses requested=chain[0][1]; when the primary model is pre-skipped (cooldown) the chain starts at the substitute, so requested==model and no fallback is recorded. Verify whether requested should always be the configured primary.
